propositions: Three acli_graph maps hand-roll identical nextPageToken cursor loops with no runaway-token guard, allowing a server that repeats the same token to spin the loop forever (cabc failure mode).
The fail-open exception handlers in all three maps (lines ~245, ~347, ~440) silently degrade pagination to partial results, masking runaway errors instead of surfacing them as data-integrity signals.
A centralized shared cursor iterator with consecutive-token duplicate detection must raise RunawayPaginationError that escapes the fail-open handlers to prevent silent partial-dict returns.

All three acli_graph maps must route through the shared cursor iterator and gain an explicit 'except RunawayPaginationError: raise' handler before their catch-all to honor the data-integrity signal while preserving degrade-open for ordinary transport faults.

Offset-protocol pagers (fetcher._iter_pages and jira_datacenter/transport.py::_paged_search) remain unchanged; cursor-pagination consolidation is a separate protocol with its own guard implementation.
